goal: Build a strong V2Ray configuration optimized for Iran internet with VLESS + Reality + WebSocket + TLS protocol stack
strategy:
1. Researched V2Ray/Xray official documentation for best practices
2. Built server config with VLESS + Reality + WebSocket on port 443 + TCP fallback on 8443
3. Built client config with SOCKS/HTTP proxies and Reality TLS verification
4. Added Iran-specific routing (direct for Iranian IPs, block ads, optimize DNS)
5. Validated both configs using v2ray_validate_config
6. Exported all artifacts to outputs/ directory
solutions: Used v2ray_build_config tool to generate server and client configs
Created comprehensive setup guide with installation instructions
